versos.texto_bv: Passados muitos dias, o SENHOR me disse:
versos.traducao_literal: E-foi ao-fim-de dias muitos, e-disse SENHOR a-mim: Levanta-te, vai Eufrates-para, e-toma dali o-cinto que ordenei-te para-escondê-lo ali.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0022): O texto_bv traz apenas a oração introdutória ("Passados muitos dias, o SENHOR me disse:") e omite por completo o mandamento direto que o hebraico e a tradução literal registram na sequência ("Levanta-te, vai ao Eufrates, e toma dali o cinto que te ordenei esconder ali"). Corrigir isso exigiria traduzir e inserir conteúdo inteiramente ausente — algo que excede a forma e não pode ser feito por um revisor gramatical sem risco à fidelidade. — evidência: traducao_literal: "...e-disse SENHOR a-mim: Levanta-te, vai Eufrates-para, e-toma dali o-cinto que ordenei-te para-escondê-lo ali."; termos_originais confirma os verbos ק֚וּם (levanta-te), לֵ֣ךְ (vai), וְקַ֤ח (e toma), צִוִּיתִ֖יךָ (ordenei-te), לְטָמְנוֹ (para escondê-lo); KJV: "...that the Lord said unto me, Arise, go to Euphrates, and take the girdle from thence, which I commanded thee to hide there." — nada disso está no texto_bv.

kjv.texto: And it came to pass after many days, that the Lord said unto me, Arise, go to Euphrates, and take the girdle from thence, which I commanded thee to hide there.

vizinhos.5: So I went, and hid it by Euphrates, as the Lord commanded me.
vizinhos.7: Then I went to Euphrates, and digged, and took the girdle from the place where I had hid it: and, behold, the girdle was marred, it was profitable for nothing.

web.texto: After many days, Yahweh said to me, Arise, go to the Euphrates, and take the belt from there, which I commanded you to hide there.

vizinhos.5: So I went, and hid it by the Euphrates, as Yahweh commanded me.
vizinhos.7: Then I went to the Euphrates, and dug, and took the belt from the place where I had hidden it; and behold, the belt was marred, it was profitable for nothing.
